handoff: Review approve: AC1-3 met (tiers, fixtures, helpers at roots, both repo rules with fixture cases; guard 189/0; test titles identical before/after per package). bun test 974/0, test:integration 505/0, typecheck green. Minor: slice guard check names unit-guard.ts (library) instead of unit-guard-preload.ts; nit: snapshot seed() duplicated across halves.

findings.title: The slice's guard check preloads the library, not the preload, so it guards nothing
findings.detail:
The check is `bun test --preload ./test/support/unit-guard.ts …`; unit-guard.ts only exports installUnitGuard, the file that installs it is unit-guard-preload.ts. Notes say: 'The guard's path in the check is where slice 02 put it; adjust the check to that path.' The handoff records the right command but the slice file was not changed. AC2 itself holds (verified with the preload, 189/0).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Change the check to `--preload ./test/support/unit-guard-preload.ts` (or leave to slice 06 docs pass).

findings.title: seed() duplicated in the unit and integration halves of snapshot
findings.detail:
`function seed(root, title)` is byte-identical in packages/store/test/unit/snapshot.test.ts and packages/store/test/integration/snapshot.test.ts (duplicated code smell).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Move it into packages/store/test/helpers.ts, which already serves both tiers.
